overview_description.description: Palomma is a tech company that saves merchants in the community money on card fees by allowing customers to pay directly from their bank at checkout. It enables users to make secure payments with their bank account with a single click and earn rewards in affiliated businesses. With secure, one-click bank payments, merchants can reduce processing costs while increasing conversion.

product.name: Palomma Payments API
product.description: An API service enabling secure online payments for merchants, allowing users to pay via credit/debit cards, bank accounts, and other methods.

identifier.value: Bill Collection and Payment via WhatsApp

product.name: Bill Collection and Payment via WhatsApp
product.description: A service that enables merchants to collect payments from users through WhatsApp messaging without leaving the app.

product.name: Funds Dispersion Service
product.description: A service that allows merchants to disperse funds to users through Palomma acting as their representative.

product.name: Automatic Debit Service
product.description: A service that allows users to register automatic debits for recurring payments to merchants.
